My name is Omar Hassan and I am writing to apply for the Chevening scholarship. Since my childhood I have always been passionate about leadership and helping people.

I am a pharmacist and I worked in many places. I was the head of the student union in my faculty and I organized various events. Unfortunately the education in Egypt is not good so I had to learn everything by myself. I think I will probably be a good leader in the future.

In 2021 I volunteered with a charity. The event was organized by me and a lot of people attended. This experience taught me the value of teamwork and highlighted the importance of communication. Furthermore I was also part of a youth initiative. Moreover I did a training.

I like to go out with my friends every Thursday to a coffee shop where we discuss ideas.

All of this makes me an excellent candidate. Thank you for reading and I am looking forward to hearing from you.
